hooks.command: i=$(cat); case $(printf %s "$i" | sed -e h -e 's/\\\\//g' -e 's/\\n//g' -e x -e 's/\\\\\\\\//g' -e 's/\\\\n//g' -e G -e 's/\\//g' -e "s/[\$'\"]//g" -e p -e :x -e h -e 's/{\([-+0-9A-Za-z]*\)\.\.[-+0-9A-Za-z.]*}/\1/g' -e 's/{\([^{},]*\)\(,[^{},]*\)\{0,8\}}/\1/g' -e p -e g -e ty -e :y -e 's/{[^{},]*,\([^{},]*\(,[^{},]*\)\{0,7\}\)}/{\1}/g' -e tx -e d) in *simctl*|*adb*|*emulator*|*avdmanager*|*playwright-cli*|*@playwright/cli*|*agent-browser*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; s="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; d="$s"; while [ ! -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agentlane" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ ! -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agentlane" ]; then d=$(git -C "$s" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r l; do w=${l#worktree }; if [ "$w" != "$l" ] && [ -x "$w/node_modules/.bin/agentlane" ]; then printf %s "$w"; break; fi; done); fi; if [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agentlane" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | "$d/node_modules/.bin/agentlane" hook pre-tool-use --agent claude; exit; fi; exit 0
